name: Loyiso Nkosenhle Sibaca
title: Data Engineer & .NET Software Developer
tagline: I build scalable data pipelines and clean, reliable web apps.
about:
I'm a developer with three focused tracks that I keep separate.

As a Data Engineer, I build reliable ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and reporting models.
Stack: SQL Server, T-SQL, Python (Pandas), Power BI.

As a .NET Developer, I build clean, scalable web apps and APIs.
Stack: C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, Blazor.

As a Python Web Developer, I build lightweight, fast web apps and APIs.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, SQL Server.

I'm currently finishing my Diploma in ICT at DUT and I'm part of DotNet Ninjas. Recent work includes Indlela (The Way), a unified learning hub for Geekulcha (2026), and a Clinic Management System for Clayton Garden Home.

I'm available for freelance and full-time roles in Data Engineering, .NET, or Python development.
